title: Liberty Agent Settlement job handoff
description: JSON Schema for a shareable Settlement job handoff payload. Same decoded object as `#handoff/h1.…` / `?handoff=` after compact short keys expand (job-handoff.js). Client-held demo; Liberty does not persist jobs, take custody, or move real money. A handoff is not a custody transfer.

JobId.description: Job id assigned at create. as_ plus 10 hex characters.

Amount.description: Job amount in integer demo credits. Not real money.

Credits.description: Integer demo credits. Not real money. fee and agentPayout on the snapshot; not payer or agent wallet balances.

Criteria.description: Success criteria. Same text as the job.

Proof.description: Proof URL or text. May be empty until submit.

Created.description: Created stamp from the job. Live jobs use ISO-8601 UTC. Handoff decode requires a non-empty string.

Stamp.description: Funded, submitted, or resolved stamp. Null if that step has no time. Must be a string or null — other types are rejected.

ExpiresAt.description: Optional escrow hold expiry stamped on fund. Handoff decode requires a string when present (no date-time re-check).

ClientRef.description: Adapter/correlation id stamped on create. Empty or whitespace-only is dropped.

CallbackUrl.description: Adapter-owned URL stamped on create (notify_url alias). Max 512. Handoff decode does not re-check https. Liberty never HTTP-fetches or calls it.

Note.description: Optional note. Whitespace-only is ignored. Max 400 after trim. proofNote kept on submitted/released/disputed; releaseNote only on released; disputeReason only on disputed.

Status.description: Current settlement state. Next legal actions follow this status.

NextActions.description: Next legal actions for this snapshot. Encode writes them from status. Decode uses the array when present, otherwise derives from status. Empty when the job is terminal.

Job.description: Expanded job after compact keys expand. Canonical camelCase matches the UI and POST /api/v0/transition job. snake_case aliases are accepted by decode. Compact short keys (t, a, s, …) are encoding-only inside an h1. token — expand them before POSTing the job. Credits, wallets, receipts, and the demo API key are not in this object.

CompactJob.description: Packed job inside an h1. token ({ v: 1, job, next }). Short keys only. Clients expand these to the Job fields before POST /api/v0/transition. Not a second public API.

HandoffPayload.description: JSON inside an h1. base64url token after compact job keys expand. Hash form is #handoff/<token>. Query form is ?handoff=<token>. Credits, receipts, wallets, and the demo API key are not in this payload. Not a custody transfer.

v.description: Handoff version. Only v=1 is accepted.
